text: ANDREY OVERRIDE §24: (1) remove Doc/Card/Tile buttons — ONE canvas mode, content adapts to zoom only. (2) scroll over a node = node-only, NEVER hand off to canvas (remove boundary-release); pan by moving mouse off node. (3) UN-MERGE: separate SPEC node (section prose blocks) ↔ 1:1 edges ↔ PLAN node (section rows) ↔ tasks. Reverses the §22.2 one-node merge — spec+plan are two connected sectioned nodes showing section mapping.

Integrated plan-spec-rich-content: Plan/Spec section bodies now delegate through a SectionMarkdownBody wrapper with data-renderer=rich-markdown and focused coverage for markdown headings, code blocks, copy affordance, and mermaid rendering. Verified SectionNode.richContent.test.tsx 2/2, cards.test.tsx 18/18, npx tsc --noEmit, and CODETERM_API_PORT=7686 ./build.sh check.
